description: Create an IVR mapping job for a phone number: its name, number, config and tags. This saves the job and nothing else: it places no call and starts no run, and the job comes back with status="idle" and no currentRun. A run is what calls the number, navigates the menu by DTMF and/or voice, transcribes the audio and analyses it with AI to discover the branches (typically 2-15 minutes, depending on tree depth). Start a run with startMapping. Check listMappings first: if a job for this number exists, run that one instead of saving another. Use when: the user asks to map a number.

allOf.description:
Per-job configuration knobs that govern exploration shape and call orchestration.
Sensible defaults are applied server-side when fields are omitted on create.

carrierRouteId.description:
Bring-your-own-carrier (invite-only). Dial this map's calls through one of the
workspace's carrier routes, over the workspace's own SIP trunk, instead of nopaque's
network. Checked when the map is created or updated (400 when it cannot be dialled, 503
when it could not be looked up). Each run records the route it started through
(`carrier`), and every call of the run checks it again, with the trunk's daily minutes:
a start that cannot dial is refused (409, 429 for today's minutes, 403 or 503), and a
call later in the map that cannot (the route was disabled, or the trunk used today's
minutes) fails that step with the reason, so the map stops dialling. Never a normal
call instead. Send `null` on update to clear it. Carrier calls are metered as
`carrier_mapping` (`carrier_s2s` for full-audio maps), from answer.

dataProfileId.description: Data profile for variable substitution in scripted inputs.

enrichmentConfig.description:
Enrichment pipeline configuration. Controls whether async post-map enrichment
runs after a mapping run completes (quality scoring, transcript analysis, etc.).

enabled.description: Whether enrichment runs automatically after each mapping run completes.

types.description: Which enrichment types to run. Defaults to `["quality_scoring"]`.

allOf.description:
The transcription language of a STANDARD test or a MAPPING run — the
language the callee is expected to speak, used to transcribe the call.
Absent means `en-GB`: every omit path is unchanged, so an existing
config without the field transcribes as British English exactly as
before. Anything outside this set is rejected with 400.

The English variants lead, then `multi` (code-switching), then the
remaining languages alphabetically by display label. Mirrors
`api/packages/core/transcription/languages.ts` (Zod) — the single
source of truth; a drift test keeps this enum equal to it.

DISTINCT from `CallLanguage`, which is the language a MISSION test
call is held in. The two lists do not overlap cleanly and are not
interchangeable: bare `en` is a valid `CallLanguage` and is INVALID
here (use `en-GB` or `en-US`), and most codes here are not call
languages at all.

language.description:
Transcription language for this mapping run. Omitted means `en-GB`.
Must be one of the `TranscriptionLanguage` codes — NOT a
`CallLanguage`: bare `en` is rejected with 400.

mappingMode.description:
Mapping mode. `dtmf` is keypad-only; `dtmf-audio` mixes DTMF + voice;
`full-audio` is voice-first (no keypad).

maxDepth.description: Maximum tree depth to explore (0 = root only).

probeMode.description:
Phase 31 security-probe mode flag. Requires a prior attestation via
`POST /mapping/attest` for the target phone number.

repeatConfig.description:
Repeat-detection configuration. Controls how the orchestrator handles
situations where a discovered menu is revisited via a different DTMF path
(a loop). `skip` ignores the revisit entirely; `explore_once` explores it
the first time only; `explore_n` explores up to `maxExplorations` times.

behavior.description: Behaviour when a repeated menu is detected.

retryConfig.description:
Retry configuration for failed mapping calls. Controls whether transient call
failures (no answer, busy, telephony errors) are retried before being marked failed.

enabled.description: Whether retries are enabled for this job.

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts per failed call (1-5).

vertical.description: Industry vertical used for prompt-library lookup.

voiceProfileId.description: Voice profile for TTS responses (full-audio / dtmf-audio modes).

phoneNumber.description: Target phone number in E.164 format.

profileId.description:
Data profile used to supply scripted input values during the run. A profile id is
`profile_` followed by base-36 characters, not a UUID.

tags.description:
Up to 10 lowercase kebab-case labels for filtering and organisation.
Normalised server-side (trimmed, lowercased, de-duplicated).

name: createMapping

outputSchema.description:
A mapping job — a configured IVR-discovery task targeting a single phone number.
Lifecycle is `idle` → `queued` → `running` → `completed | failed | limited`.
A job is reusable across runs; `currentRunId` tracks the most-recent run.

currentRun.description:
Nested run summary on single-job responses (Phase 04 D-09 / D-10).
`currentRun.status` is the run's own status (`queued`, `running`, `completed`,
`failed` or `limited`); read it to decide whether the discovery is done. The
flat `status` on the job response is a copy of it, except that `queued` shows
as `idle`.

The field name stays `currentRun` even when `?version=N` is supplied — the
wrapper describes the run this response describes (active by default, or
the historical run identified by `version`).

stats.description: Aggregate statistics for the current run, populated while the job executes.

loopsDetected.description: Number of times a repeated menu was detected.

retriedCalls.description: Calls that required at least one retry.

totalCalls.description: Total calls placed so far in this run.

status.description:
The run's own status. A run has finished when it is `completed`, `failed` or
`limited`. The job response's flat `status` copies it, with `queued` shown as `idle`.

currentRunId.description: Identifier of the most-recent run (absent if never started).

error.description: Error message if the job failed.

limitReason.description: Reason the run stopped early (only present when `status` is `limited`).

phoneNumber.description: Target phone number in E.164 format.

runNumber.description:
Flat-merged run number from the active or requested (via `?version=`) run.
Phase 04 D-09 — preserved at top level for frontend back-compat alongside
the new nested `currentRun` object.

stats.description: Aggregate statistics for the current run, populated while the job executes.

loopsDetected.description: Number of times a repeated menu was detected.

retriedCalls.description: Calls that required at least one retry.

totalCalls.description: Total calls placed so far in this run.

status.description:
On getMappingJob, the status of the run the response describes (a copy of
`currentRun.status`, with `queued` shown as `idle`), or `idle` when the job
has never run. createMappingJob returns `idle`: creating a job places no
call and starts no run (POST /mapping/{id}/start does).

tags.description: String labels for filtering and grouping. Lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens.
